title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Reed College
description: Ten publicly accessible Portland food and convenience destinations with currently documented late hours; verify hours before leaving.

cards.title: Taco Bell on SE Powell
cards.subtitle: 4933 SE Powell Blvd, Portland
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru when you need a food stop after most nearby counters have closed; confirm the ordering format before heading out.
cards.short_summary: A SE Powell drive-thru with exceptionally late published hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The official location page lists drive-thru service from 7 a.m. to 3 a.m. every day.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists drive-thru hours of 7 a.m.–3 a.m. daily; dine-in hours are listed separately and end earlier.

cards.entity_name: Taco Bell, 8181 SE Johnson Creek Blvd
cards.title: Taco Bell on SE Johnson Creek
cards.subtitle: 8181 SE Johnson Creek Blvd, Portland
cards.notes: Keep this as a later-hours option on the southeast side; use the published location page to check service details before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: A southeast Portland drive-thru open into the early morning.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell's Portland locations page lists this restaurant as open until 3 a.m. and identifies it as an open-late drive-thru location.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell Restaurants in Portland, Oregon
cards.access_notes: The official Portland locator lists 8181 SE Johnson Creek Blvd as open until 3 a.m., with drive-thru and Open Late services.

cards.title: Krispy Kreme on SE 82nd
cards.subtitle: 9950 SE 82nd Ave, Portland
cards.notes: Choose this for a late bakery stop on SE 82nd; check the store page again for holiday exceptions before making a dedicated trip.
cards.short_summary: A Portland doughnut shop with published 24-hour access.
cards.evidence_claim: Krispy Kreme's official location page identifies the 9950 SE 82nd Ave shop as open 24 hours.

cards.title: Baby Doll Pizza SE
cards.subtitle: 2835 SE Stark St, Portland
cards.notes: Plan a pizza pickup around the posted weekend window, and use the contact page to confirm the day’s service before traveling across town.
cards.short_summary: SE Stark pizza with a documented midnight Friday–Saturday close.
cards.evidence_claim: Baby Doll Pizza lists its SE Stark location as open until midnight on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.source_title: Baby Doll Pizza — Contact and Hours
cards.access_notes: Official hours list 11 a.m.–midnight Friday and Saturday; Sunday through Thursday close at 11 p.m.

cards.title: Sizzle Pie Downtown
cards.subtitle: 949 SW Oak St, Portland
cards.notes: Use the downtown shop for a clearly timed late pizza pickup, and check its location page before going in case operating hours change.
cards.short_summary: Downtown pizza with a published midnight closing time every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Sizzle Pie's official Downtown location page lists hours of 11 a.m. to midnight every day.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists 11 a.m.–midnight every day.

cards.title: Lúc Lác Vietnamese Kitchen
cards.subtitle: 835 SW 2nd Ave, Portland
cards.notes: For an evening meal downtown, check the restaurant’s current dinner window and place a pickup order before the published kitchen close.
cards.short_summary: Downtown Vietnamese restaurant with dinner service through 11 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Lúc Lác's official site lists dinner every day from 4 p.m. to 11 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists dinner daily, 4–11 p.m.; its patio also closes at 11 p.m.

cards.title: Voodoo Doughnut Old Town
cards.subtitle: 22 SW 3rd Ave, Portland
cards.notes: Use this Old Town doughnut counter only for a straightforward food pickup, and recheck its official location listing for day-specific changes.
cards.short_summary: The original Portland Voodoo location offers nearly round-the-clock doughnuts.
cards.evidence_claim: Voodoo Doughnut's official site says its shops are open “almost” 24 hours, and its Old Town ordering page identifies the 22 SW 3rd Ave location.
cards.access_notes: The official site describes Voodoo as open “almost” 24 hours; confirm the Old Town shop’s current hours before travel.

cards.title: WinCo Foods on SE Powell
cards.subtitle: 7979 SE Powell Blvd, Portland
cards.notes: Make a grocery-list stop rather than relying on restaurant service; check the store finder for holiday exceptions and current department availability.
cards.short_summary: A SE Powell grocery destination with corporate 24-hour operating guidance.
cards.evidence_claim: WinCo identifies its Portland-Powell store at 7979 SE Powell Blvd, and its official FAQ says most WinCo locations operate 24 hours a day, seven days a week.
cards.access_notes: WinCo states most locations are open 24 hours daily, with holiday exceptions; confirm this specific store before travel.

cards.title: Plaid Pantry at 82nd and Duke
cards.subtitle: 6440 SE 82nd & Duke, Portland
cards.notes: Use this convenience stop for a quick essentials run; the location page lists amenities and lets you confirm availability before you leave.
cards.short_summary: A Southeast Portland convenience store listed as open around the clock.
cards.evidence_claim: Plaid Pantry's official page for 82nd and Duke lists the store's hours as open 24 hours every day.
cards.access_notes: Official store page lists Open 24 hours for Monday through Sunday.

cards.title: Banning's Restaurant & Pie House
cards.subtitle: 11477 SW Pacific Hwy, Tigard
cards.notes: Save this for a planned Friday or Saturday diner-style meal; the official directions page shows a later weekend close than the rest of the week.
cards.short_summary: A Tigard restaurant with documented 11 p.m. Friday–Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Banning's official directions page lists Friday and Saturday hours from 7 a.m. to 11 p.m.
cards.source_title: Banning's Restaurant & Pie House — Directions and Hours
cards.access_notes: Official hours list Friday–Saturday, 7 a.m.–11 p.m.; other listed days end at 10 p.m.
